articles.summary: June 23, 2023 , Auburn Hills, Mich. – “Stellantis Spotlight” is a weekly recap of some of the major stories at Stellantis. The top stories for the week ending June 23, 2023, include J.D. Power IQS results, partnership announcements and a new summer campaign kick-off for Grand Wagoneer.
